reviews.title: Works as intended; abit large however.
reviews.comment: Waited a few weeks before reviewing. I own a Omen 30L desktop, have a I9-10900k watercooled CPU, and previously had a Omen 3060ti. I've been playing games on 4k previously on the 3060ti with significant sacrifice and frame drops. Now with the Asus 4070tis I confidential can run most games on Ultra 4k. As for temps, it stays in the 50-60C range and much cooler than my 3060ti. (Overwatch, War thunder, Squad 44, GTA 5: runs above 144fps on ultra 4k. Cyberpunk 2077: Needed to use performance dlss, but Ultra on all settings, ray tracing only used for reflections, stable 60-70fps modded,) It is a big card btw; I was shocked and abit scared it wouldn't fit my case, that was the key factor in me getting a asus 2 fan model over a 3 fan. Luckily it was able to fit but I was forced to remove the gpu bracket and my glass case won't fit with the power cable. Double check your measurements and maybe invest in one of those angled pin adapters. Regardless money well spent.

reviews.title: DUAL Great for SFF Gaming
reviews.comment: This GPU was my #1 choice when upgrading my ASUS G22CH SFF PC as it's powerful, not power hungry, and compact. I'm running this with a i7 13700F, 32GB of DDR5 RAM, and a 600w PSU. - Temps have been at most 65C under load while gaming - Fans are very quiet... I hear my CPU cooler fans more than the GPU fans Hopefully they make a similar 50 series card, but with rumored increases in wattage demand, I would likely need to upgrade the 600w PSU as well.
reviews.author: Danton

reviews.title: Good value with great performance
reviews.comment: I've had this card for a couple of days now. Simple to install, even in my older mid-tower case. It replaced my well served Zotac 1080 GTX. Only have tried a few newer games, but at 3440X1440 on Ultra with DLSS on quality, this thing does deliver. Framerates hover around 90-100. Compared to my 1080, this runs much hotter, so make sure you have a case with good ventilation to keep it cool. As for noise levels, it's as quiet as my 1080 so far. Very happy with this card so far.
